authority_contract.system_intent_zh: 为 agent.1 至 agent.6 建立一套可直接投影到正文、图纸、双语网页与结构化矩阵的实质城市设计内容模型，同时严格区分仓库事实、案例事实、概念建议与外部证据缺口。
authority_contract.system_intent_en: Create a substantive urban-design content model for agent.1 through agent.6 that can be projected into the proposal, drawings, bilingual web pages and structured matrices while strictly separating repository facts, case facts, concept proposals and external evidence gaps.
authoritative_for: minimum scenario, persona, test, landmark and component counts
authority_contract.required_boundary_zh: 所有空间落地建议均为概念建议、参考方案或可供专业团队深化研究的方向；不替代正式规划，不构成政府审定结论。
authority_contract.required_boundary_en: Every spatial proposition is a concept proposal, reference option or direction for professional deepening; it does not replace statutory planning or constitute a government determination.

E.rule: Use only within the stated authority scope of an identified source.

I.rule: Never present as observed, approved, funded or operational.

U.rule: Do not replace with zero, a guessed value or decorative precision.

BLOCKED.rule: Cannot be promoted to an implementation conclusion until the named evidence is obtained and reviewed.

external_gates.minimum_evidence: Official/cleared CAD, GIS or equivalent spatial package, CRS, version, licence, control lines, parcels and relevant ownership/heritage summaries.
Dated route, photos, measurements, slopes, clear widths, crossings, obstacles, opening conditions and independent repeat walk.
Accessible compensated participation, benefit-burden mapping, dissent, withdrawal and non-adoption reasons.
Named accountable roles, legal basis, service hours, incident SLA, appeal, remedy, retention, deletion and operating contracts.
Quantity basis, checked cost range, FTE, three-year TCO, insurance, open interfaces, migration, deletion and witnessed AI-off/exit test.

external_gates.title_zh: 独立专业与可访问性保证
external_gates.minimum_evidence: Named discipline reviews, dispositions, PDF/UA, assistive-technology checks and physical A0 distance test.

brand_and_overall_concept.descriptor_zh: 一条把创新转化为日常公共价值的开放城市骨架
brand_and_overall_concept.descriptor_en: An open civic spine that turns innovation into everyday public value
brand_and_overall_concept.tagline_en: A New Way Forward. Always for People.
brand_and_overall_concept.decision_frame_zh: 概念可评审，实施有门槛
brand_and_overall_concept.decision_frame_en: Reviewable as a concept. Gated for implementation.
brand_and_overall_concept.memory_structure_zh: 一轴、三域、两翼、十二区景、四级开放、六道证据门
brand_and_overall_concept.memory_structure_en: One spine, three zones, two wings, twelve scenarios, four opening levels and six evidence gates
brand_and_overall_concept.core_proposition_zh: 以京张遗址公园及周边地区的公开任务语境为一条南北公共服务脊：北部众智园验证全栈创新，中部AI原点社区把科研转译为人人可用的服务，南部大钟寺把智能原生业态接入城市日常；中关村科技服务翼提供知识、资本与专业服务接口，小月河场景赋能翼承接公共需求与真实场景验证。AI在线时增强，人工可随时接管，AI关闭时同一公共服务仍可继续。
brand_and_overall_concept.core_proposition_en: Use the public brief's JingZhang heritage-park context as a north-south civic-service spine: Zhongzhiyuan in the north tests full-stack innovation, the AI Origin Community in the middle translates research into services that people can use, and Dazhongsi in the south connects intelligent-native activity with everyday city life. The Zhongguancun Technology Service Wing supplies knowledge, capital and professional-service interfaces; the Xiaoyuehe Scenario Empowerment Wing carries public needs and real-world validation. AI augments when available, people can take over at any time, and the same public service continues when AI is off.

logo_direction.concept_zh: 以两条平行轨线构成开放括号，中间串联三个非封闭节点；左右各伸出一条细翼线。平行轨线代表京张记忆与公共服务连续性，三个节点代表三区，两条翼线代表知识服务与场景赋能，开放端表示系统可继续学习而非封闭品牌徽章。
logo_direction.concept_en: Form an open bracket from two parallel rail lines, linking three open nodes with one fine wing line on each side. The parallel lines stand for JingZhang memory and service continuity; the nodes stand for the three zones; the wing lines stand for knowledge services and scenario empowerment; the open ends show a system that keeps learning rather than a closed crest.
geometry_rules: Use only simple participant-authored line, circle and open-bracket primitives.
Keep the three nodes distinct at small sizes and in monochrome.
Never imitate a railway operator, government, university or company mark.
The mark must work without animation and without AI-generated imagery.

identity_tokens.meaning_zh: 可信背景与公共机构可读性
阻断、停止与未满足证据

accessibility_rules: Colour is never the only carrier of zone, state or direction.
Every status uses a word label and a distinct shape/pattern.
Chinese and English marks are separate composed masters, not overprinted bilingual microtext.
Exact contrast and tactile/audio performance remain subject to X6.

spatial_structure.one_spine: A legible north-south civic-service sequence connecting the three key-area roles; exact alignment, width, crossings and heritage interface remain X1/X2/X6.
spatial_structure.cross_city_logic: The spine does not claim a single construction corridor. It is a service-and-story sequence whose physical segments must be recalculated from official and field evidence.

evidence review and GO / REVISE / STOP

invariants: GO means eligibility to seek the project party's next-stage approval; it never means automatic implementation.
REVISE returns to evidence acquisition, not cosmetic rewording.
STOP preserves negative results and returns to the do-nothing baseline.
Every digital path has a human takeover and a functionally equivalent AI-off path.
Every expansion decision includes burden, maintenance, exit and non-adoption evidence.

precedent_cases.name: Smart Kalasatama
precedent_cases.primary_mechanism_zh: 以真实城区作为受治理的共创与试验平台，把居民日常价值而非技术炫示作为评估对象。
precedent_cases.primary_mechanism_en: Use a real district as a governed co-creation and experimentation platform, evaluating everyday value rather than technology spectacle.
transfer_to_jingzhang: public problem intake before vendor solution
small bounded pilots
resident burden and time-use review
publish negative results and exit reasons
precedent_cases.non_transfer_rule: No Helsinki governance model, result or user finding is evidence of JingZhang feasibility.

precedent_cases.name: Helsinki Innovation Districts
precedent_cases.primary_mechanism_zh: 把创新活动分布到多个日常社区，形成可比较、可学习的生活实验网络。
precedent_cases.primary_mechanism_en: Distribute innovation activity across everyday neighbourhoods to create a comparable, learning-oriented living-lab network.
transfer_to_jingzhang: one shared evidence protocol across three differentiated zones
portable scenario cards instead of one flagship object
cross-zone learning reviews
local variation with a common public-interest baseline
precedent_cases.non_transfer_rule: No named Helsinki district arrangement or result is copied as a local commitment.

precedent_cases.name: JTC LaunchPad
precedent_cases.primary_mechanism_zh: 通过共享支持、邻近协作和分阶段空间供给形成创业生态，而不是只提供一栋标志建筑。
precedent_cases.primary_mechanism_en: Build an entrepreneurship ecosystem through shared support, proximity and staged space provision rather than a single landmark building.
transfer_to_jingzhang: shared validation and service rooms
graduated space and support pathways
peer exchange with transparent entry and exit
support small teams without claiming guaranteed growth
precedent_cases.non_transfer_rule: No tenancy, investment, land or institutional arrangement is transferred without local authority and evidence.

precedent_cases.name: Punggol Digital District
precedent_cases.primary_mechanism_zh: 把产业、教育与地区运营界面组织在同一城区系统中，并以可管理的地区平台连接参与方。
precedent_cases.primary_mechanism_en: Organise industry, education and district-operation interfaces in one urban system and connect participants through a governable district platform.
transfer_to_jingzhang: research-to-service translation interfaces
shared operating data contracts rather than proprietary lock-in
district-level AI-off and incident drills
campus-city interfaces subject to public-access rules
precedent_cases.non_transfer_rule: No Singapore platform, data rule or institutional commitment is authority for JingZhang.

precedent_cases.name: Waterfront Toronto / Sidewalk Labs termination
precedent_cases.primary_mechanism_zh: 把终止、权责边界和公共机构最终判断视为创新治理的一部分，而不是失败后删除的附注。
precedent_cases.primary_mechanism_en: Treat termination, authority boundaries and final public-institution judgement as part of innovation governance rather than a footnote erased after failure.
transfer_to_jingzhang: explicit STOP path
vendor exit and data deletion clauses
public-interest authority retained by named human institutions
no automatic expansion from demonstration to city system
precedent_cases.non_transfer_rule: This is a governance lesson, not proof of local risk, legal advice or project comparability.

enabling_resources.rule: Do not infer demand, availability or commitment; validate roles and safeguarding.
Use space types only until X1 confirms parcels, controls and rights.
Use capability categories, not invented company lists, output or recruitment commitments.
Describe a review interface only; no funding, subsidy or return is promised.
Capacity, energy, security, procurement and service level remain X4/X5/X6.
Start with synthetic or minimum necessary data; legal basis and contracts remain X4.
A scenario is a testable hypothesis, not an approved operation.
Named authority, appeal, remedy, audit, export, deletion and STOP are mandatory before a public pilot.

feedback_loops: user burden and non-adoption -> problem reframing
negative test result -> protocol revision or STOP
maintenance and AI-off drill -> procurement requirements
public contribution record -> reusable knowledge commons

scenario_cards.public_problem_hypothesis: People may need a legible, step-free and non-smartphone-dependent path from arrival to daily destinations.
scenario_cards.spatial_setting: station-city threshold, staffed help point and slow-mobility decision points; exact entrance and route U
scenario_cards.ai_online: Offer optional route explanation and disruption updates without automated final accessibility claims.
scenario_cards.human_takeover: A named staffed help channel checks exceptions and can override guidance.
scenario_cards.ai_off: High-contrast physical signs, printed route card and staffed/telephone help provide the same core function.
scenario_cards.minimum_data: destination category, selected accessibility need and current public disruption; no identity required by default
scenario_cards.public_value: independent access and reduced wrong-route burden
evaluation_questions: Can all three service paths complete the same core journey task?
What extra time, distance and assistance burden falls on each user group?

scenario_cards.public_problem_hypothesis: A resident may need to understand and complete a service request without being forced into one digital channel.
scenario_cards.spatial_setting: quiet shared service interface with private consultation option
scenario_cards.ai_online: Plain-language explanation and form assistance, never final eligibility or enforcement decisions.
scenario_cards.human_takeover: A service worker reviews, corrects and accepts appeals.
scenario_cards.ai_off: Counter, phone and paper route remain available and equivalent for the core transaction.
scenario_cards.minimum_data: only fields legally necessary for the chosen transaction
evaluation_questions: Can a non-smartphone user complete the task?
Can a frontline worker explain and reverse every system action?

scenario_cards.public_problem_hypothesis: Digital change and renewal can shift rent, footfall, workload or platform power onto existing operators.
scenario_cards.spatial_setting: existing commercial interface and optional shared service point; exact businesses and tenancies U
scenario_cards.ai_online: Optional translation, queue or inventory support using exportable data and no opaque merchant ranking.
scenario_cards.human_takeover: Merchant and named operator approve changes, disputes and shutdown.
scenario_cards.ai_off: Cash/manual ordering, physical directory and human service preserve the core transaction.
scenario_cards.minimum_data: merchant-selected operational fields; no forced customer profiling
scenario_cards.public_value: continuity, fair participation and non-adoption rights
evaluation_questions: Who gains and who carries new cost or labour?
Can a merchant leave without losing core records or access?

scenario_cards.public_problem_hypothesis: Researchers and external collaborators need clear, rights-bounded ways to find facilities, partners and public programmes.
scenario_cards.spatial_setting: public-facing collaboration desk and bookable commons outside controlled research areas
scenario_cards.ai_online: Optional capability matching from public, consented profiles with explanation and correction.
scenario_cards.human_takeover: A programme steward validates introductions and resolves rights or safeguarding questions.
scenario_cards.ai_off: Curated directory, staffed desk and scheduled open sessions preserve discovery and introduction.
scenario_cards.minimum_data: public capability tags and contact choice; no inferred sensitive attributes
scenario_cards.public_value: lower-friction knowledge exchange with clear rights
evaluation_questions: Does matching create a useful introduction without overstating affiliation?
Can the same opportunity be found offline?

scenario_cards.public_problem_hypothesis: A person may need visible, non-surveillant help after normal service hours.
scenario_cards.spatial_setting: lit human-help beacon at verified public nodes; exact nodes and service hours U
scenario_cards.ai_online: Optional multilingual triage that never performs automated enforcement or identity recognition.
scenario_cards.human_takeover: A trained human service or emergency authority makes final triage and response decisions.
scenario_cards.ai_off: Clearly marked phone/intercom, lighting and published human response route remain operational.
scenario_cards.minimum_data: help category, location and caller-chosen contact; retain only under a lawful incident rule
scenario_cards.public_value: visible and accountable access to help
evaluation_questions: Can someone obtain help without surrendering unnecessary identity data?
What happens during power, network or model failure?

scenario_cards.name_zh: 长者与非智能手机服务
scenario_cards.public_problem_hypothesis: A service system can exclude people who do not own, trust or confidently use a smartphone.
scenario_cards.spatial_setting: staffed daily-service point connected to physical wayfinding and seating
scenario_cards.ai_online: Optional spoken or visual explanation with simple confirmation and no hidden scoring.
scenario_cards.human_takeover: A trained person can complete the full task and correct the record.
scenario_cards.ai_off: Paper, phone, counter and volunteer-supported route remain the default-capable baseline.
scenario_cards.minimum_data: transaction minimum only; no inferred vulnerability profile
scenario_cards.public_value: dignity, choice and continuity across digital confidence levels
evaluation_questions: Can the task be completed without a personal device?
Does assistance reduce or add workload and embarrassment?

scenario_cards.name_zh: 公共空间活动与多语参与
scenario_cards.public_problem_hypothesis: Public events can become commercially dominant, linguistically exclusive or inaccessible without explicit public-use rules.
scenario_cards.spatial_setting: reversible event kit in a verified public space with protected clear routes
scenario_cards.ai_online: Optional live captioning, translation and schedule explanation with visible confidence limits.
scenario_cards.human_takeover: Event steward corrects translation, manages safeguarding and maintains access.
scenario_cards.ai_off: Printed bilingual schedule, human interpreters where commissioned and physical noticeboard preserve core participation.
scenario_cards.minimum_data: anonymous attendance count where lawful; registration only when necessary and consented
scenario_cards.public_value: open cultural and technical participation without commercial capture
evaluation_questions: Who can participate without registration or a device?
Does the event leave a reusable public record rather than only promotion?

scenario_cards.name_zh: 蓝绿空间维护与公众工单
scenario_cards.name_en: Blue-Green Maintenance and Public Work Orders
scenario_cards.public_problem_hypothesis: Maintenance signals may help prioritise care, but sensor or model output cannot replace field inspection and accountable work orders.
scenario_cards.spatial_setting: blue-green care marker and maintenance access point; ecological and hydraulic conditions U
scenario_cards.ai_online: Summarise public reports and sensor alerts for human inspection priority, with source and confidence shown.
scenario_cards.human_takeover: A qualified maintainer verifies conditions and authorises action.
scenario_cards.ai_off: Scheduled inspection, phone/paper work order and visible maintenance log continue.
scenario_cards.minimum_data: location, issue type, time and optional contact; no bystander surveillance
scenario_cards.public_value: visible stewardship and faster accountable maintenance
evaluation_questions: Does the system improve verified response rather than produce alerts only?
Can the public see disposition and unresolved risk?

scenario_cards.public_problem_hypothesis: Civic AI claims need repeatable tests, human takeover and exit evidence before exposure to real users or systems.
scenario_cards.spatial_setting: bounded test cell separated from production systems and public routes
scenario_cards.ai_online: Run declared tests on synthetic or cleared de-identified data with complete logs.
scenario_cards.human_takeover: Test lead can pause, inspect and invalidate a run.
scenario_cards.ai_off: Manual procedure and low-tech control demonstrate the service baseline and recovery path.
scenario_cards.minimum_data: synthetic by default; any cleared dataset requires purpose, licence, minimisation and retention record
scenario_cards.public_value: evidence before procurement or public exposure
hard_stops: no vendor exit or reproducible control
evaluation_questions: Can another reviewer reproduce the test and the failure?
Does AI-off restore the agreed core service?

scenario_cards.name_zh: 机器人与智能终端受控测试
scenario_cards.public_problem_hypothesis: Embodied systems need a bounded test with physical separation, manual stop and accessibility review before any public-space operation.
scenario_cards.spatial_setting: enclosed or clearly separated low-speed test bay; no route or engineering geometry approved
scenario_cards.ai_online: Execute a declared low-speed task with geofencing, visible status and incident logging.
scenario_cards.human_takeover: A trained supervisor holds an immediate physical stop and final decision authority.
scenario_cards.ai_off: The test stops safely; any service task transfers to a human or non-robotic method.
scenario_cards.minimum_data: system telemetry and test-zone safety records; no general facial recognition
scenario_cards.public_value: safe validation without treating public space as an unconsented laboratory
evaluation_questions: Is the test intelligible to bystanders and independently stoppable?
Can the service continue without the robot?

scenario_cards.public_problem_hypothesis: People need a place to understand what an AI-enabled service does, what it cannot do and how to challenge it.
scenario_cards.spatial_setting: quiet learning commons linked to the contribution and evidence display
scenario_cards.ai_online: Interactive explanation uses current, cited examples and exposes uncertainty and data boundaries.
scenario_cards.human_takeover: Facilitator answers questions, corrects content and records unresolved challenges.
scenario_cards.ai_off: Printed explainers, physical models and facilitated workshops deliver the same learning goals.
scenario_cards.minimum_data: none for walk-in learning; optional anonymous questions
hard_stops: collection of participant profiles without need
evaluation_questions: Can a visitor explain the service limits and appeal route after the session?
Are dissent and unresolved questions retained in the record?

scenario_cards.name_zh: 城市事件响应与证据保全
scenario_cards.name_en: Urban Incident Response and Evidence Preservation
scenario_cards.public_problem_hypothesis: An AI-enabled service needs an explicit incident path that protects people, preserves evidence and defers to lawful authority.
scenario_cards.spatial_setting: operating protocol visible at every service point rather than a new physical control room claim
scenario_cards.ai_online: Detect declared service anomalies and present evidence to a human without automated final enforcement.
scenario_cards.human_takeover: Named incident lead decides pause, notification, remedy and authority escalation.
scenario_cards.ai_off: Service returns to the published manual baseline; logs and affected-person contact routes remain available.
scenario_cards.minimum_data: incident-essential records under a lawful retention schedule
scenario_cards.public_value: accountability, remedy and continuity under failure
hard_stops: no affected-person notice or remedy path
evaluation_questions: Can the named human stop the system and restore the baseline?
Can an affected person understand, appeal and obtain remedy?

industry_tests.name_zh: 城市AI可靠性与退出沙盒
industry_tests.name_en: Civic AI Reliability and Exit Sandbox
industry_tests.test_design: Compare a declared AI service with a low-tech control, human takeover and AI-off recovery using synthetic or cleared data.
industry_tests.pass_boundary: Pass is limited to the stated test environment and version; it is never approval for public deployment.
industry_tests.test_design_en: Compare a declared AI service with a low-tech control, human takeover and AI-off recovery using synthetic or cleared data.
industry_tests.pass_boundary_en: Pass is limited to the stated test environment and version; it is never approval for public deployment.
industry_tests.test_design_zh: 使用合成数据或已获许可数据，将一个已声明 AI 服务与低技术对照、人工接管和 AI-off 恢复进行比较。
minimum_outputs_zh: 供应商导出与删除测试
industry_tests.pass_boundary_zh: 通过仅适用于已声明的测试环境与版本，绝不等同于公共部署批准。

industry_tests.name_zh: 科研到公共服务转译共测
industry_tests.test_design: Turn one research capability into a plain-language, optional service hypothesis and test comprehension, burden, takeover and non-adoption with compensated participants.

network_concept.description_zh: 以京张遗址公园的公开任务语境串联三处区域地标，并以分布式贡献长廊贯穿全带、双向慢行决策点、低技术服务点与蓝绿照护节点；强调南北叙事连续和东西日常接口。具体路径、跨越、桥隧、文保、绿地、蓝线和工程可行性均不作结论。

No conclusion is made about exact routes, crossings, bridges, tunnels, heritage controls, green/blue lines or engineering feasibility.

culture_and_wayfinding.narrative_name_zh: 从铁路开路到知识开源
culture_and_wayfinding.narrative_name_en: From Opening a Railway to Opening Knowledge
culture_and_wayfinding.narrative_zh: 叙事不把铁路文化当作科技装饰，而把“连接、维护、协作与持续服务”作为跨越三种时代的公共价值：京张铁路历史文化提示城市基础设施如何连接人与地方；中关村创新文化提示知识如何通过科研、创业和协作进入城市；AI新文化则要求算法、数据与模型的贡献、局限、失败和退出都能被公众理解与追溯。具体历史事件、遗存、人物、年代与文保价值须由权威历史资源清单和专业审查补齐。
culture_and_wayfinding.narrative_en: The narrative does not use railway culture as technological decoration. It treats connection, maintenance, collaboration and continuity of service as public values spanning three eras: JingZhang railway culture asks how infrastructure connects people and places; Zhongguancun innovation culture asks how knowledge enters the city through research, entrepreneurship and collaboration; AI culture requires the contributions, limits, failures and exits of algorithms, data and models to remain understandable and traceable to the public. Specific events, heritage assets, people, dates and conservation values require an authoritative historical inventory and professional review.

measures.name: service parity coverage

measures.name: accessible journey completion

measures.name: burden delta

measures.name: exit completeness
measures.formula: required exports, deletions, migrations, manual recovery and contractual exits witnessed / required exit steps

measures.name: negative-result publication
measures.formula: completed tests with plain-language failure/STOP record / completed tests

measures.name: contribution traceability
measures.formula: displayed contributions with source, licence, state, limitation and correction route / displayed contributions

measures.name: public-space continuity
measures.formula: verified route/service segments remaining usable during AI-off and incident drills / verified segments

semantic_rules: Every cited path and fragment must exist in the package.
Every visual-section anchor named in compliance_matrix.json must exist as an HTML id.
Every numeric metric displayed in visual/index.html must have matching data-metric/data-value and metrics.json authority.
English figures and PDFs must be independently rendered English compositions, not duplicated Chinese files.
A scenario title alone is not a scenario card; render problem, user, spatial setting, three service paths, data minimum, value, hard stop, state and gates.
A design-depth matrix marked complete must point to locatable human-readable and visual evidence.
GO always routes to the project party's next-stage approval; no content may imply automatic construction or operation.
